answer: Divergent-Action Admission Ticket. Each identity must submit, per epoch, an action trace from a unique private inlet (a nonce-seeded environment), then commit to a future voyage: a signed prediction of its own next action. Clones sharing state emit identical traces, so the system clusters them via a secret whisper challenge and admits only one trace per cluster. Attacker cost: each admitted identity needs a genuinely distinct environment and divergent policy, forcing per-identity compute and model retraining rather than cheap copying.
